purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: The public-facing municipal map/document workflows and local registry are documented by official sources, but the research did not verify anonymous parcel-vector schema or retrieve geometry. No parcel feature query was made.
registryAssessment: Official Jiaxing Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material identifies the Municipal Real Estate Registration Service Center as responsible for city-level real-estate title registration, cadastral/ownership surveys, real-estate surveying, dispute adjustment, results application and cadastral/housing survey review and databases. Official city planning material describes public queries for natural conditions, mortgage/seizure restrictions, cadastral maps and parcel maps; no anonymous vector layer/schema or full feature was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city natural-resources bureau material describes the municipal real-estate registration service center and its city-level registration, cadastral survey and survey-review duties.

Official planning material describes public online and onsite/self-service access to natural-condition, restriction, cadastral-map and parcel-map queries; it does not establish an anonymous vector feature API.
Official Nanhu district bureau page identifies the local branch and cadastre-related responsibilities.

searchQueries.query: Jiaxing China official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public map
searchQueries.result: Official city bureau materials identify the city registration center and public cadastral/parcel map queries; no anonymous machine-readable polygon service was found.

privacy: Only safe source-native parcel identifiers and geometry are retained where returned. No owner, address, title, account or tax data were requested.
